# PhysxTendonAttachmentLeafAPI

Leaf attachment of a spatial tendon, applied as PhysxTendonAttachmentLeafAPI:<name>; it closes one sub-tendon and carries its rest length and limits.

- **Applies to:** [`Xformable`](glossary.md#xformable)
- **Multi-apply:** applied as `PhysxTendonAttachmentLeafAPI:<instance>`; `<inst>` in a column name is the instance. Instances: any instance name.
- **Read only when listed in [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns).**

## What USD population writes

Every declared attribute of an applied instance is published at its resolved value; [USD](glossary.md#usd) auto-applies PhysxTendonAttachmentAPI:<name> with it.

## Columns

*Raw fallback* is the USD schema value. *Producer writes* is what [ovstage](glossary.md#ovstage) population puts in the column for a USD stage. *Parser default* applies on the consumer when the column is absent, in stage units. **diverges** means writing the raw fallback literally parses differently from omitting the column (the parser default): USD population may well publish that very value for an unauthored attribute, so the marker is about the column being present, not about its value.

| Column | Type | Units | Raw fallback | Producer writes | Parser default | If absent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `physxTendon:<inst>:restLength` | float32 | length | `-inf` | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | `-FLT_MAX` | -FLT_MAX (unset). |
| `physxTendon:<inst>:lowerLimit` | float32 | length | `-inf` | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | `-FLT_MAX` | -FLT_MAX: no lower limit. |
| `physxTendon:<inst>:upperLimit` | float32 | length | `inf` | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | `FLT_MAX` | FLT_MAX: no upper limit. Clamped to at least the lower limit. |

## Interactions

- **[`PhysxTendonAttachmentAPI`](PhysxTendonAttachmentAPI.md):** Owns gearing, localPos, parentAttachment and parentLink, which the parser reads for the leaf too.

## Notes

- Instance names are arbitrary (one per tendon), so the compiled cache declares every physxTendon:* column.
